findings.claim: with the organization picker's options pinned to COUNTRY_OPTIONS, no control on any screen can clear the organization country once one is set, and no export holds a label for an option that would

witness.detail: contracts.md:344 states the picker's options are COUNTRY_OPTIONS from @devscribed/validation — the 249 assigned codes of COUNTRY_NAMES (autofill.ts:970), none of which is an empty value. The member picker beside it names its extra first option explicitly (contracts.md:359-361, TIME_OFF_CALENDAR_MESSAGES.memberCountryDefaultOption), which is how the document states one when it wants one, so the organization picker's list is 249 options and nothing above them. REQ-01-034 and Edge case 19 both describe an admin clearing the organization country; after this change that write is reachable only through the API, and every case for it (TC-01-INT-12, TC-01-INT-21, TC-01-INT-24) already goes that way. A label invented on the screen would be a user-facing string in no packages/validation export and in no row of the closed Error Messages table, so the plan does not invent one.

findings.suggestedFix: either one clause in §Screens giving the organization picker a first option that means 'no country stated', with a TIME_OFF_CALENDAR_MESSAGES row for its label, or one line saying clearing is an API rule and the screen offers no control for it. Planned as the document states it: 249 options, a stored null painting the Select's placeholder

findings.claim: the organization-country control this spec adds ships with a control width no token names, and the DS gaps table — which the spec says is where anything @ds lacks is recorded — has no row for it

witness.detail: The control is drawn inside style={{ minWidth: 220 }} (apps/web/app/org/[orgId]/settings/holidays/page.tsx:363), the same literal the country filter directly below it carries at :391 and the same order of magnitude as MultiFilter's own 200. The DS gaps table (contracts.md:370-374) records --name-col and the three sub---space-1 literals and nothing else, while its own preamble says '@ds carries none of what the rows below name. Each row says what ships in its place'. So the screen carries a fourth measurement the table does not answer for. A note and not a blocker: the literal already ships on the neighbouring control in the same file, so matching it invents nothing, and the plan changes neither.

findings.suggestedFix: one DS-gaps row for a control width — what ships in its place and what closes it — covering both selects in that column; or a width token in @devscribed/ds, which the reports filters would take as well

findings.claim: the README calls the holidays and reports suites ones 'this area does not touch and which must stay green'; four of their cases pin the very source REQ-01-026 drops and cannot stay green untouched

witness.detail: e2e/tests/holidays.spec.ts:296-338 (TC-03-E2E-04) seeds a holiday with countryCode 'BY', calls setOwnCountryViaApi(request, 'BY') at :309 — which writes Account.phoneCountryCode — and asserts the weekly calendar's holiday marker. Under REQ-01-026 that member has no Membership.countryCode and the organization has none, so the chain resolves null and the marker is not drawn. Three integration cases are in the same position: apps/api/test/holidays.spec.ts:381, apps/api/test/reports-amounts-owed.spec.ts:573 and :607, apps/api/test/reports-time-off.spec.ts:404. Carried from round 1 unchanged: the product rule is stated completely (the contracts' call-site table, 'No call site keeps a phone-country read') and the repair is mechanical, which is why it is a note.

findings.suggestedFix: the sentence should say those four cases move their fixture from the phone column to the stated one while every assertion stands. Planned as T10, a task of its own so the edits read as deliberate, and now also requiring each moved fixture to be able to fail

findings.claim: the case says a user and a viewer 'receive the identical body' from the member detail read, and the shipped projection carries caller-dependent fields, so a literal reading cannot pass

witness.detail: MembersService.getDetail returns callerRole, canEditRole and availableRoles (apps/api/src/members/members.service.ts:352-374); callerRole is 'user' for one caller and 'viewer' for the other, so a deep-equality assertion between the two bodies fails on fields this spec does not touch. The rest of the sentence says what is meant — 'field included: the read is gated by no capability and the field is not conditional on one'. Carried from round 1 unchanged.

findings.suggestedFix: narrow the clause to the field the case is about. Planned as: countryCode present and equal for both callers, alongside the target-derived fields; no product code differs between the two readings
